content.overview: Agreements in restraint of marriage (s. 26), restraint of trade (s. 27), restraint of legal proceedings (s. 28, as amended), uncertain agreements (s. 29), and wagers (s. 30) are void to the extent the Act provides.

sections.heading: Restraint of trade
sections.body: Section 27 voids restraints on lawful profession, trade or business to that extent, subject to limited exceptions such as sale of goodwill.

sections.heading: Wager and uncertainty
sections.body: Wagering agreements are void (s. 30). Agreements must be certain or capable of being made certain (s. 29).

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Plead the statutory head of voidness. Distinguish void ab initio from voidable consent cases.
